rows.instruction: 给毕业照中两张脸没照到太阳的地方加些亮度，明亮的天空保持。
Give the unlit parts of both faces a little light, with the bright sky left alone.
毕业照的暗面想再沉一点，天空和受光的衣服留住。
Make the shaded parts of the graduation photo deeper while retaining the sky and lit clothing.
把这张毕业照整张提亮，脸和背景、天空都要有变化。
Raise the whole graduation photograph a little, including faces, background and sky.
整张毕业照偏亮，收一点整体曝光，别压没衣服纹理。
Take the entire graduation photo down a little in exposure, preserving clothing texture.
把合照里偏暗的脸和衣服带亮一些，墙上灯的亮度保持。
Bring up the shadowed faces and clothes in the group without raising the wall lamp.
要加深人像暗调，吊灯的亮部不用变。
Give the people deeper shadows while leaving the bright lamp alone.
合照太暗，让人和墙、灯附近都更亮一点。
The group photograph is too dim. Brighten the whole frame including people, walls and areas near the lamp.
把合照整体再暗一点，墙面和人都一起收。
Lower the whole group photograph a little, darkening both the wall and people.
把赛车下面与近处阴影抬亮些，明亮车漆和天保留。
Lighten the shade under the race cars and in front, keeping the bright paint and sky unchanged.
车辆下面的阴影稍深一点，车漆高光和云保持。
Take the shadows beneath the cars a bit deeper, retaining paint highlights and clouds.
场地、车和天空一起提亮一些，保住车身和云层的细节。
Brighten the entire race scene, including ground, cars and sky, while retaining paint and cloud detail.
整张车场照片降低一点曝光，保留原有色彩和可见细节。
Give the whole race scene a small reduction in exposure, keeping the colours and visible detail.
让湖边近处树石的暗部能看清一点，天边晚霞别跟着变亮。
Reveal a little more in the dark foreground by the lake, keeping the sunset unchanged.
把湖边前景暗面收深一些，天空的日落渐变保持。
Darken the foreground shadow tones at the lake and retain the sunset gradient.
整幅湖边图增加一些曝光，前景、远山和天空都抬起来。
Increase exposure across the lake scene, lifting foreground, mountains and sky together.
整张湖边照整体调暗，天和地一起往下收一点。
Darken the lake photo across the frame, bringing down both sky and ground.
把楼梯下没照到光的地方提起来，楼上的灯别跟着亮。
Put more light into the shade under the stairs; leave the upstairs lights at the same level.
把最暗的层次轻轻往上拉，高光按原来的样子。
Bring the lowest tones up gently while holding the highlights in place.
只让画面里的暗处沉下去一点，受光的地方留原样。
Let the shaded parts sink a little darker; keep illuminated areas where they are.
压低深灰区域的亮度，不调整整体曝光。
Lower brightness in the deep greys without adjusting overall exposure.
整体比现在亮一点，暗部和亮部都一起变化。
Make the image brighter across the board, not just in its shadows.
从天空到地面都增加一些亮度，保留原色。
Raise the brightness from sky to ground while keeping the original colours.
整幅照片收暗半档，天空也要一起收。
Take the entire shot half a stop down, including the sky.
室内这张整体太亮，连白墙也一起暗一点。
This indoor shot is too bright all over. Bring it all down, including the white wall.
亮度不动，只把色温调冷一些。
Leave brightness as it is and make the white balance a little cooler.
先提阴影，再给整张加点复古棕色。
Lift the shadows and then add a vintage brown tone to the whole picture.
只把阳光照到的地方压一点，树荫不用变。
Tone down the sunlit areas only; keep the shade unchanged.
照片还是原来的样子就好，别动暗处或亮处。
Keep the photo the way it is, without changes to dark or bright areas.
给脸上背光的部分补一点亮度，已经亮的地方保持。
Open up the dim side of the face a bit and leave the lit side alone.
把画面里的暗处提起来一截，天上亮云原样保留。
Bring up the darker tones so more is visible, leaving the bright clouds as they are.
把树下的阴影压得更深，天和水面不用变。
Deepen the shade below the trees and leave the sky and water as they are.
拉低暗部的亮度，让人像的阴影更有深度，白衫别变。
Pull the shadow tones down for a deeper portrait, leaving the white shirt alone.
这张整体太暗了，整幅图的曝光提一档。
The whole frame is too dim. Bring the exposure up a notch across the image.
全画面再亮一点，包括前景、人物和天空，保留层次。
Give the entire photo a little more light, including the foreground, people and sky, while keeping tonal detail.
整张稍微压暗一些，别只改阴影。
Make the whole photograph a little darker, including its lighter areas.
整体曝光太高，整幅画面往回收一档。
The shot is too bright overall. Bring the exposure down across the frame.
降低整体对比度，尽量保持平均亮度。
Reduce overall contrast while keeping the average brightness about the same.
提亮脸上的暗部，再把天空的高光压下来。
Lift the shadowed parts of the face and also pull down the bright sky highlights.
看看要不要调整曝光，保留现在的气氛。
See if the exposure needs a change, while preserving the current mood.
暗部和亮部都原样保留，什么也别改。
Leave the shadows and highlights exactly as they are and make no changes.
请原样保留，不要编辑。
Keep the picture unchanged.
请把背景里的路人移除。
Remove the person in the background.
加一点棕褐色的复古色调。
Add a subtle brown sepia tone.
把整张照片的曝光明显提高。
Raise the exposure of the whole photograph noticeably.
显著压暗阴影，保持高光。
Darken the shadows noticeably, preserving highlights.
把暗部提亮，亮部原样保留。
Lift the shadows and keep the highlights unchanged.
暗部只提一点点，但同一处暗部也要大幅提亮。
Lift the shadows a little, but also lift the same shadows substantially.
明显提亮阴影，不要提亮高光。
Lift the shadows noticeably, but do not brighten the highlights.
